control position: Diamond Parent Holdings is the vehicle of the 2016 take-private of Diligent Corporation ($4.90 per share, about $624M); it files from the firm's own address with three of its partners.

control position: Drilling Info Holdings is the company now called Enverus. control position: Eagle Parent Holdings is the vehicle of the 2015 take-private of E2open: 'E2open Signs Definitive Agreement To Be Acquired By Insight Venture Partners' (the firm's post, 2015-02-05).

control position: Epsilon Group New Holdings is the holding company of Episerver, now Optimizely, which was sold to Insight Venture Partners for $1.16B in September 2018; five of the firm's partners sit on its Form D.
